name_note: GTDB g__Fimenecus corresponds to Candidatus Fimenecus; its species are mostly uncultured placeholders such as Fimenecus sp000432435, the name used in the cited human study.

sentences.text: That study reported Fimenecus sp000432435 as a robust biomarker for psoriasis, achieving an area under the curve of 0.84.
Genomic functional prediction in that study indicated this species encodes pathways with the potential for B-vitamin and secondary bile acid biosynthesis.
A study of faecal microbiota in lactating sows reported that the Fimenecus genus was less abundant on one enzyme-supplemented diet than on two others.
